instruction.text: 5 groups are entered into a science competition. Each group has 9 children. How many children are at the competition altogether?
30 players have turned up to training. They are split into 3 groups. How many children are in each group?
10 teams play basketball. Each team has 4 children. How many children play basketball altogether?
Iris has 40 toy animals. She splits them into groups of 5. How many groups of animals does Iris make?
7 teams have entered a football competition. Each team has 5 players. How many players are at the tournament altogether?
10 teams play hockey. There are 60 children altogether. How many children are in each team?
45 children are taking part in PE class. They are split into 9 groups. How many children are in each group?
There are 16 children in Miss Reeves’ class. They are working on projects in groups of 2. How many groups are there?
